quote: It’s a cardinal rule - you never want someone to buy your product, you want someone to own your product. And why (!) would they want to own your product?

quote: It's dangerous, it's very dangerous. On one hand, we want to be supportive of this, because this gives opportunities, definitely, to fuel new companies. But on the other hand, there's a lot of irresponsibilities that go with this. There's a lot of fraud that's being created
